arithmetic.question: does the exit rule declared in FINDING-161 -- look out of turn when the cell underfoot holds less than the upkeep -- remove the stop that made memory catastrophic
arithmetic.declared_rule: FINDING-161: 'look out of turn when the current cell holds less than the upkeep'. The rule is `World::look_on_shortfall`, off by default; `needs_look = world.look_on_shortfall && field.level(cell) < maintenance_cost + damage_rate * repair_cost`
arithmetic.threshold_why_upkeep: upkeep = maintenance_cost + damage_rate * repair_cost is exactly what one step costs before any income, so a cell below it cannot feed the organism. The wording is FINDING-161's, written before the model was changed; it is a declared rule, not a tuned number
arithmetic.prediction_before_run: (a) at look_on_shortfall = true the number of moves stops being zero in the environments where it was zero; (b) the median loss falls from the order of -10001 to the order of -10; (c) the share of wins does not grow substantially

operational_thresholds.a: every environment with moves_off == 0 has moves_on > 0

arithmetic.prior: reused from checks/exp_env_prior.py: 216 environments, peaks, period {4,6,8}, poor {0.20,0.35,0.50}, regrow {0.78,0.80,0.82}, start {0,3,6,9}, P_need {1,2}
arithmetic.contrast: lifetime(intact) - lifetime(sighted), both pay the same price
arithmetic.replication: the unit of replication is the environment: FINDING-158 measured sigma = 0 across seeds on a fixed scene

fires.evidence: of 189 environments where the old schedule made 0 moves, 45 make at least one move with the rule: the switch changes the behaviour it was meant to change

silent.evidence: in 126 environment/price pairs the rule never fired (shortfall_looks = 0), so the intact hashes must be identical: True

specific.evidence: at the same price and on the same environments the losses fall only when the rule is on: off {0.05: 66, 0.02: 42}, on {0.05: 0, 0.02: 0}

verdict.reason: EXPLAINED: the falsifiable expectation of FINDING-161 did not hold in the mechanism it named (missed point(s) a,b). (a) 45/189 of the environments that made 0 moves now move, but 144 still make 0 -- and in every one of those the sighted arm makes 0 moves too, so the stop there is the environment (no richer neighbour), not the memory. (b) the median loss is undefined rather than about -10: with the rule on, intact's lifetime equals sighted's in 432/432 cases and its moves in 432/432, so dF = 0 everywhere and both tails are empty. (c) the win share did not grow (it fell from 0.199 to 0.000), but the wins did not remain small: they disappeared together with the losses. The rule removes the catastrophe by removing the memory: when the cell underfoot is poor it looks on every step, and a memory that looks every step is the sighted policy.

limitations: this is the declared prior of 216 environments, not all environments; another family or other weights inside this one would give another number
the read period is still fixed by the price, and the rule is the only new degree of freedom: a rule tuned per environment is not tested
one seed per environment; FINDING-158 measured sigma = 0 across seeds on a fixed scene, so the environment is the unit of replication -- but only that scene was checked for determinism
the rule says WHEN to look, not WHAT to find: if both neighbours are poor too, an out-of-turn look still learns nothing and the organism can stop
the probe re-states the Life::Memory loop; the rule is pinned in core/tests/exit_rule.rs, but the probe is a second copy of the schedule
delta is a tenth of the control lifetime; the tails are reported with Wilson intervals, not tested against a null distribution
